post.summary: Create an account and send the verification email (AUTH-01, AUTH-10).
Verify the email address with the token from the link (AUTH-10).
Send the verification email again, at most once a minute (AUTH-10).
Sign in with email and password on this device (AUTH-02).
Sign in with Google, linking an account with the same email (AUTH-11).
Rotate the refresh credential and issue a new access token (D-13).
Sign out this device and revoke its credentials on the server (AUTH-02).
Sign out one device and close its live channel (AUTH-05).

schema.description: UUID; clients generate v7 IDs for what they create.

post.summary: Change the password; signs out the other devices (AUTH-06).
Ask to change the email; the new address must be verified first (AUTH-06).
Confirm the new email with the token from the link (AUTH-06).
Email a reset link; the answer never reveals whether the email exists (AUTH-07).
Set a new password with the reset token; signs out the other devices (AUTH-07).
Confirm the timezone and receive the starter tags (AUTH-12, R-15, TAG-07).
Hard-delete the account and all its data (AUTH-08).
Start a session; while one runs, return it unchanged (R-01, R-02).
End the running session at the press; a no-op while idle (R-02, R-06).
Change the running session's title or tag (TIM-02).
